name: Ikemen Oukoku◆Joou to Shinjitsu no Kiss
original_name: イケメン王国◆女王と真実のキス
source:
This is the peaceful small country of Bramble Kingdom.
But one day, I realized that I was being targeted by a great power ...-

"You are the queen of this country."
-You were suddenly selected as a queen.
Its only mission is ato have a "contract marriage" to protect the country ...!?

The encounter and love of 11 of them from five countries will lead to their destiny.

"Swear with this kiss ... you're the only queen of me."　
When the crown shines above you, the lie turns into a true kiss.

[Taken from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/news/info/news2015.02.17.html]Official Website[/url]]
translation:
這裡是寧靜的小國，布蘭布爾王國。
然而，某天，我發現強大的國家正對這裡虎視眈眈……

「你就是這個國家的女王。」
——你突然被選為女王。
唯一的使命竟是透過「契約婚姻」保護國家……？！

與來自五個國家的11位男性相遇、相戀，將引領彼此走向命運。

「以這一吻起誓……你是我唯一的女王。」
當王冠在你頭頂閃耀，謊言也將化作真心的一吻。

[摘自[url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/news/info/news2015.02.17.html]官方網站[/url]]
